'''Ernst Kötter''' (1859-1922) was a German mathematician.

==Education==
Kötter graduated in 1884 from the [[University of Berlin]] under the supervision of [[Karl Weierstrass]] and [[Leopold Kronecker]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=9717}}</ref>

==Career==
Kötter's treatise ''"Fundamentals of a purely geometrical theory of [[algebraic plane curve]]s"'' gained the 1886 prize of the [[Berlin Royal Academy]].<ref>{{cite journal| author=Norman Fraser| title=Kötter's synthetic geometry of algebraic curves| journal=Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society|date=Feb 1888| volume=7| pages=46–61| doi=10.1017/s0013091500030364| doi-access=free}} Here: p.46</ref>

In 1901, he published his report on ''"The development of [[synthetic geometry]] from [[Monge]] to [[Karl Georg Christian von Staudt|Staudt]] (1847)"'';<ref>{{cite book| author=Ernst Kötter| title=Die Entwickelung der Synthetischen Geometrie von Monge bis auf Staudt (1847)| year=1901| url=http://gdz-lucene.tc.sub.uni-goettingen.de/gcs/gcs?&action=pdf&metsFile=PPN37721857X_0005&divID=LOG_0035&pagesize=original&pdfTitlePage=http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/dms/load/pdftitle/?metsFile=PPN37721857X_0005%7C&targetFileName=PPN37721857X_0005_LOG_0035.pdf&| access-date=2019-08-10| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304074153/http://gdz-lucene.tc.sub.uni-goettingen.de/gcs/gcs?&action=pdf&metsFile=PPN37721857X_0005&divID=LOG_0035&pagesize=original&pdfTitlePage=http%3A%2F%2Fgdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de%2Fdms%2Fload%2Fpdftitle%2F%3FmetsFile%3DPPN37721857X_0005%7C&targetFileName=PPN37721857X_0005_LOG_0035.pdf&| archive-date=2016-03-04| url-status=dead}} (2012 Reprint as {{ISBN|1275932649}})</ref>
it had been sent to the press as early as 1897, but completion was deferred by Kötter's appointment to [[Aachen University]] and a subsequent persisting illness.<ref>Kötter (1901), Preface, p.VIII</ref>
He constructed a mobile wood model to illustrate the theorems of [[Dandelin spheres]].<ref>{{cite journal| journal=Jahresbericht der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung| volume=16 | year=1907 | title=Vermischtes (Miscellany) |page=82 |url=http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/dms/load/img/?PPN=PPN37721857X_0016&DMDID=DMDLOG_0016}}</ref><ref>[http://www.math.rug.nl/models/Serie32_nr2.html Illustration] of [[Groningen University]]</ref>
<!---more notable facts yet to be gathered--->

In a discussion with [[Schoenflies]] and Kötter, [[Hilbert]] reportedly uttered his famous quotation according to which [[point (geometry)|point]]s, [[Line (geometry)|line]]s, and [[plane (geometry)|plane]]s in geometry could be named as well ''"tables, chairs, and beer mugs"''.<ref>{{cite book| author=Otto Blumenthal| author-link=Otto Blumenthal| title=Lebensgeschichte| year=1935| volume=3| pages=388–429| publisher=Julius Springer| editor=David Hilbert| series=Gesammelte Abhandlungen| url=http://gdz-lucene.tc.sub.uni-goettingen.de/gcs/gcs?action=pdf&metsFile=PPN237834022&divID=LOG_0001&pagesize=original&pdfTitlePage=http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/dms/load/pdftitle/?metsFile=PPN237834022%7C&targetFileName=PPN237834022_LOG_0001.pdf&| access-date=2019-08-10| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304122623/http://gdz-lucene.tc.sub.uni-goettingen.de/gcs/gcs?action=pdf&metsFile=PPN237834022&divID=LOG_0001&pagesize=original&pdfTitlePage=http%3A%2F%2Fgdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de%2Fdms%2Fload%2Fpdftitle%2F%3FmetsFile%3DPPN237834022%7C&targetFileName=PPN237834022_LOG_0001.pdf&| archive-date=2016-03-04| url-status=dead}} Here: p.402-403</ref>
